privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heroSub: We know you're scrolling straight to the bottom.
privacy.heroSubMuted: But if anyone asks: you totally read this. Pinky promise.
privacy.outro: No data monsters. No fine print. Just Bingo. 🎲

data.title: 2. What data?
data.content: Email and username (on registration), game states, created boards, and technical connection data (IP, browser) in server logs.
data.note: No data about your favourite colour. Promise.

purpose.title: 3. What for?
purpose.content: Exclusively for authentication, game states and board management. Not for ads, not for data brokers, not for evil things.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies
cookies.content: Just one session cookie for login. No tracking, no marketing, no annoying banners (except this one).
cookies.note: This cookie is purely technical — and unfortunately not edible.

sharing.title: 5. Data Sharing
sharing.content: No sharing with third parties. No transfer to third countries. Your data stays here — boringly safe.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.content: Access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability — you've got them all. Just email us:

retention.title: 7. Retention
retention.content: As long as your account exists. After deletion, all personal data is removed within 30 days.
retention.note: Your high scores too, unfortunately. Sorry.
